sharedContinuityRules: Every avatar is an original fictional character and must not imitate an identifiable person.
Face geometry, hair, apparent age, skin details, body proportions and signature wardrobe are version-locked after source approval.
Each avatar keeps one primary audience function and cannot become an interchangeable generic presenter.
Eyeline, gesture range, speaking pace and emotional baseline must be defined per performance plan.
Only locally generated or rights-cleared audio may drive the avatar; HeyGem voice extraction and training are prohibited.
Every output requires synthetic-media disclosure, private review and provider lineage.
